parse.title: Martial Demon (Destruction)
parse.text:
Overview

Martial Demon (Destruction) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable by evolving Martial Demon. He is also the boss of stage 4 of Snowy Town as The Ice Demon.

Evolving

Martial Demon (Destruction) can be evolved from Martial Demon with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: Compass Needle

After 12 seconds (two attacks), Martial Demon boosts his damage by 50% for around 5 seconds.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • After Update 14.0.0, Martial Demon (Destruction) has been given the Aqua damage type, along with other units without a second damage type.
